is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on malaria vectors Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus (e.g. title: 'Trends in insecticide resistance in Anopheles mosquitoes (Diptera: Culicidae) in Ghana: a systematic review', page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Table 2 (page 5) and the text discuss Vgsc-L1014F (L995F), Vgsc-1014S (L995S), Vgsc-1575Y, and Ace1-119S.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: As a systematic review, the paper only reports aggregate counts of published articles that detected specific resistance mechanisms (e.g., Table 2 reports the number and percentage of published studies reporting Vgsc-L1014F, Ace1-119S, etc.) rather than extractable mosquito-level genotype counts or allele frequencies with sample sizes.

african_field_population.evidence: The review covers published studies examining field populations of Anopheles mosquitoes across ecological zones in Ghana (page 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a secondary review article ('Trends in insecticide resistance in Anopheles mosquitoes (Diptera: Culicidae) in Ghana: a systematic review', page 1) summarizing findings from 41 previously published studies from 2001 to 2024.

sub_country_location.evidence: Results are categorized by ecological zones in Ghana: Coastal savannah, Forest zone, and Sahel savannah (Table 1, Table 2, pages 4-5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reviews publications spanning 2001 to 2024 and aggregates data into multi-year brackets (e.g., 2001-2005, 2006-2011, 2012-2017, 2018-2024).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a systematic review re-analyzing data from 41 primary research articles previously published between 2001 and 2024 (page 1, 4).

supplement.evidence: No supplemental files needed; the paper is inherently ineligible as a systematic review.

assessment.summary: This paper is a systematic review summarizing 41 studies on insecticide resistance and resistance mechanisms (including Vgsc L995F, L995S, N1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus from Ghana published between 2001 and 2024. Because it is not a primary study and does not provide extractable primary population genotype data, it is not eligible.
